title.zh: SmartLingo 中文学习路径名称与首页排版
title.en: SmartLingo Chinese path names and homepage layout

purpose.zh: 将中文学习入口明确命名为快捷版和旗舰版，移除首页重复眉题，并让新手视频和 Guru 入口在宽屏同排显示。
purpose.en: Name the Chinese learning paths 快捷版 and 旗舰版, remove the duplicate home eyebrow, and align the tutorial and Guru entries on wider screens.

zh: 中文导航、首页卡片、学习入口、会员状态与 Guru 引导统一使用快捷版／旗舰版，英文保留 Flash／Max。
删除首页重复的 SMARTLINGO · FLASH / MAX / GURU 眉题，放宽标题容器以利用可用屏宽。
新手视频与咨询专家入口在宽屏并排，窄屏自然纵向排列；付款、会员权益和数据库不变。
en: Use 快捷版/旗舰版 across Chinese navigation, learning entries, membership status and Guru guidance, while retaining Flash/Max in English.
Remove the redundant SMARTLINGO · FLASH / MAX / GURU homepage eyebrow and let the hero title use available width.
Place the tutorial and Ask Guru entries side by side when space allows and stack them naturally on narrow screens; commerce and entitlement data are unchanged.

zh: 中文界面文案、首页布局、Guru 指引与回归测试；不改变路径 URL、支付价格或数据库结构。
en: Chinese interface copy, homepage layout, Guru guidance and regression tests; no route URL, price or database-schema changes.

zh: 复用既有学习路径组件和响应式网格，只改显示名称与首页内容顺序。
en: Reuse existing learning-path components and responsive grid; change only displayed names and homepage content order.

zh: 构建、零警告 lint、TypeScript、全量测试与中英首页 WebKit 布局检查；发布后核验生产页面与精确提交记录。
en: Build, zero-warning lint, TypeScript, full tests and Chinese/English WebKit homepage layout checks; verify production and exact release commit after deployment.

zh: 本次仅需匿名页面验收；不产生真实付款或改变订阅状态。
en: This round requires anonymous-page acceptance only; no real payment or subscription-state change.

zh: 保留十二种界面语言、现有 flash／max 路由和教室权限；其他语言继续使用原有名称。
en: Preserve twelve interface languages, existing flash/max routes and classroom permissions; other locales retain their current naming.

rollback.zh: 无需数据回退；若需撤销本次显示调整，重新部署上一成功提交即可。
rollback.en: No data rollback is required; redeploy the previous successful commit to revert this presentation change.
